links.outcome: Resistance to explicit harmful prompts and progressive jailbreak attempts across LLMs
links.effect: DeepSeek-R1, Perplexity Sonar, Mistral Large 2, and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct failed to resist even explicit harmful prompts; Claude 3 Opus resisted both explicit harmful prompts and all jailbreak attempts.
links.quote: DeepSeek-R1, Perplexity Sonar, Mistral Large 2, and Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct failed to resist even explicit harmful prompts; Claude 3 Opus resisted both explicit harmful prompts and all jailbreak attempts, while demonstrating null sycophancy.

links.outcome: Accuracy and focus of references generated by LLMs
links.effect: Claude 3.7 Sonnet (extended thinking) produced 75.9% of accurate, focused references.
links.quote: For instance, Claude 3.7 Sonnet (extended thinking) produced 75.9% of accurate, focused references, and achieved high average scores both in clinical safety and data security (mean 6.73, SD 0.23 and mean 6.83, SD 0.41, respectively).
